name: Scala AI City (Eldorado do Sul)
summary: Scala Data Centers plans a data centre city in Eldorado do Sul, in the Porto Alegre metropolitan region of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. It signed an agreement with the state government in September 2024 for a first phase of 54 MW of IT capacity, about BRL 3 billion, with potential growth to 4,750 MW and total investment the company puts as high as BRL 500 billion. Eldorado do Sul passed a law in December 2024 adding the site to the urban perimeter, and in May 2025 Brazil's Ministry of Mines and Energy authorized a phased grid connection of up to 5 GW. No construction start had been reported in the sources reviewed.
